scope: Two AP-side inputs that the same-board vendor stack writes and mainline did not: the MD DFD log region as a read-only diagnostic, and the DBM guard/body pattern in SMEM user 0 before the runtime doorbell.

images.content: MD DFD export plus DBM pattern written before the runtime doorbell

new_diagnostics.debugfs:op6893-md-dfd: read-only streaming text view of SMEM user 10 (RAW_DFD, 8 MiB); printable runs verbatim, every other run collapsed to one newline, paged by file position
new_diagnostics.md_dfd_info: read-only whole-region scan: bytes, nonzero byte count, printable byte count and first nonzero offset
new_diagnostics.handshake.dbm: the mapped DBM size, or 0 when the region was not usable

dfd_finding.conclusion: this firmware writes nothing into RAW_DFD, so the region is not an MD-side log source on this board and the MD-side forensics line is closed for now

vendor_log_correction.observation: the vendor boot excerpt's [1]NORMAL LOG REGION / CCCI MD INIT REGION sections come from the vendor kernel's own AP-side CCCI log buffers (ccci_private_log.c format_separate_str), not from RAW_DFD
vendor_log_correction.implication: the vendor excerpt cannot be used as evidence about MD-internal logging

dbm_finding.vendor_source: drivers/misc/mediatek/eccci/modem_sys1.c md_cd_smem_sub_region_init(): SMEM_USER_RAW_DBM gets 0x44444444 at words 0 and 1, a cleared CCCI_SMEM_SIZE_DBM (160) body, then 0x44444444 at the next two words, before the H2D_SRAM doorbell
dbm_finding.mainline_after: handshake reports dbm=512 and the 176-byte pattern is emitted
dbm_finding.first_attempt: a separate devm_request_mem_region for the DBM page failed with -EBUSY because the runtime reservation already covers 0x8e11e000-0x8e11ffff; the driver now reuses that window instead of claiming a second region

result.conclusion: the DBM pattern is a real AP-side input we were missing, but writing it changes nothing observable

decoded.md_optional: every id 1-40 and 42-44 except 41, which is NOT_SUPPORT
decoded.vendor_granted: about 35 ids, because config_ap_side_feature() declares most of them MUST and the MD asks OPTIONAL

feature_negotiation_evidence.implication: the MD tolerates every refusal (it never fails HS1), but mainline is the only stack that grants 9 features; this is now the largest remaining AP-side difference

not_claimed: that the DFD region is unused by every firmware revision
that the missing features cause the fault
